# NONoise

> AI SDLC bootstrapper. The `create-nonoise` CLI scaffolds projects with AI skills, a docs hierarchy, per-tool context files and the Polly orchestrator, and upgrades existing ones.

## For agents asked to install or update NONoise in a project

- [UPDATE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/UPDATE.md): step-by-step runbook (detect case, `npx create-nonoise@latest --upgrade <path>`, `doctor`, post-upgrade steps; the upgrade updates the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph, retires graphify, installs the Regia mod for Claude Code, installs the agents of the saved profile and stack, and removes pristine copies of the retired `swarm-router`, `copilot-delegate` and `gemini-delegate` skills)

## Docs

- [Installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/installation.md): prerequisites, native vendors, the `codebase-memory-mcp` code graph (`--code-graph-only`), Haft, profiles
- [Install profiles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/install-profiles.md): `--profile minimal|core|developer|security|brownfield|full`, and `--stack` (`dotnet`, `typescript`, `angular`, `web`, `python`, `go`, `rust`, `java`, `kotlin`, `cpp`, `swift`, `php`, `ruby`, `react`, `vue`, `flutter`, `fsharp`, or `none`)
- [Agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/agents.md): the three NONoise agents (`graph-explorer`, `blueprint-architect`, `evidence-reviewer`), the ECC agents per profile and the language reviewers and build resolvers per `--stack`, where they are installed (Claude Code, Copilot, Codex; none for Cursor and Gemini CLI), when the flow calls them, the inventory `.nonoise/ecc/index.md`, attribution to ECC
- [ECC integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/ecc-integration.md): the pinned MIT snapshot of affaan-m/ECC: rules, agents and skills per stack, per-host paths, upgrade behaviour, maintainer update
- [Skills catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/skills-catalog.md): the 27 skills of the standard bundle by domain, including `reuse-first` (adopt / extend / build before new code) and `docs-steward` (one owner document per kind of fact), plus the vendored packs
- [SDLC flow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/sdlc.md): the phases, the skills and agents each one invokes, skip rules, the brownfield prefix
- [Development modes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/development-modes.md): quick / medium / long (`/polly quick|medium|long <goal>`), the FPF gate, how Codex and Copilot apply the same modes
- [Regia](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/docs/regia.md): the orchestration layer for Claude Code (`regia@claude-regia`): `/regia long|medium|quick`, model and effort per task, swarms of Claude, Codex, Qwen Code and Copilot agents, how NONoise installs it, what it replaces, limits (Claude Code only; no delegation to Gemini CLI)
- [Contributor guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/russosalv/NONoise/main/CLAUDE.md)
